1.consolidated_definition: Acción o programa de acciones encaminadas al engaño y a la obtención de beneficios de forma ilegal. Calco de estructura, usual. Ni siquiera sabe de qué partido son, aseguró, por lo que si alguno de ellos resultara que se inscribió indebidamente, no es porque haya tal cosa como un esquema de fraude
1.en_consolidated_definition: Action or program of actions aimed at deception and the illegal acquisition of benefits. Calque of structure, usual. He even claimed not to know which party they were affiliated with, so if any of them turned out to have registered improperly, it was not because there existed such a thing as a fraud scheme.
